note.en: Declared vocabulary of the course. Every tag used in course.json, labs.json, sources.json and ideas.json must appear here. The lists are open: a new entry is added with a reason, nothing is deleted.
note.sr: Deklarisani rečnik predmeta. Svaki tag upotrebljen u course.json, labs.json, sources.json i ideas.json mora da stoji ovde. Liste su otvorene: novi unos ulazi sa razlogom, ništa se ne briše.

scope.en: Records, formats, structure, metadata, provenance.
scope.sr: Zapisi, formati, struktura, metapodaci, poreklo.

scope.en: Instructions, loops, rules executed by a machine.
scope.sr: Instrukcije, petlje, pravila koja mašina izvršava.

scope.en: Shape, measure, mesh, transformation, projection.
scope.sr: Oblik, mera, mreža, transformacija, projekcija.

scope.en: Representation, decision, composition, intent.
scope.sr: Prikaz, odluka, kompozicija, namera.

scope.en: Space, programme, building as a cultural object.
scope.sr: Prostor, program, objekat kao kulturna činjenica.

scope.en: Structure, load, element, construction technology.
scope.sr: Konstrukcija, opterećenje, element, tehnologija građenja.

scope.en: Machine, toolpath, fabrication, prototype.
scope.sr: Mašina, putanja alata, izrada, prototip.

scope.en: Sequence, state, queue, scheduling, workflow.
scope.sr: Redosled, stanje, red, raspored, tok rada.

scope.en: Earlier practice, archive, change over time.
scope.sr: Ranija praksa, arhiva, promena kroz vreme.

scope.en: How the subject is taught, checked and transferred.
scope.sr: Kako se predmet uči, proverava i prenosi.

scope.en: Model, inference, generated content and its limits.
scope.sr: Model, zaključivanje, generisani sadržaj i njegove granice.

scope.en: Tales, songs, myths, legends, testimony, public memory.
scope.sr: Priče, pesme, mitovi, legende, svedočenja, javno sećanje.

scope.en: Iconography, facade, ornament, political and cultural message.
scope.sr: Ikonografija, fasada, ornament, politička i kulturna poruka.

scope.en: Architects, engineers, competitions, project versions.
scope.sr: Arhitekte, inženjeri, konkursi, verzije projekta.

scope.en: Revisions, disputes, demolition and reconstruction.
scope.sr: Izmene, sporovi, rušenje i rekonstrukcija.

scope.en: Order of works, site organisation, labour.
scope.sr: Tok radova, organizacija gradilišta, radna snaga.

scope.en: Tools, machines, methods of work.
scope.sr: Alati, mašine, načini rada.

scope.en: What is built in, from where, in what quantity, how installed.
scope.sr: Šta je ugrađeno, odakle, u kojoj količini, kako je ugrađeno.

scope.en: Envelope, orientation, consumption, systems, maintenance.
scope.sr: Omotač, orijentacija, potrošnja, sistemi, održavanje.

scope.en: Damage, repair, measured state, remaining service life.
scope.sr: Oštećenja, popravke, izmereno stanje, preostali vek.

needs.en: Document, drawing, minutes, dated photograph or expert finding.
needs.sr: Dokument, crtež, zapisnik, datirana fotografija ili stručni nalaz.

needs.en: Date, place, method, who measured, instrument or photograph.
needs.sr: Datum, mesto, metod, ko je merio, instrument ili fotografija.

needs.en: Who says it, when, in what capacity. A trace, not yet a fact.
needs.sr: Ko tvrdi, kada, u kom svojstvu. Trag, još ne činjenica.

needs.en: Who interprets it so, where published. Documented, not verified.
needs.sr: Ko tako tumači i gde je objavljeno. Dokumentuje se, ne proverava se isto.
